prerequisites: good school knowledge in the foreign language

learning_outcomes.text: Students will typically have foreign language skills comparable to level B2 of the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
Students know presentation techniques and are able to give a convincing presentation on a technical topic* in the foreign language.
Students master basic working techniques to comprehend and reproduce foreign language technical texts*.
Students are able to communicate with foreign interlocutors about subject-specific content* in the foreign language.
Students can express themselves in writing in an appropriate form on topics of their technical field* in the foreign language.

syllabus_topics: Study and discussion of current technical texts/topics
assessment_rules: The portfolio examination comprises 40 points and consists of an Oral Examination (M) and a Presentation with an accompanying elaboration (R). A maximum of 20 points can be achieved with the Oral Examination, and a maximum of 20 points can also be achieved with the Presentation. The oral examination duration is detailed in the general part of the examination regulations. The presentation is approx. 8-10 minutes with an accompanying elaboration of approx. 2-3 pages.
